scientific_integrity: A self-contained mathematical proof accompanies reproducible exact finite checks; no independent audit or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: A within-graph colour-refinement orbit classification, not identifiability against arbitrary finite graphs.
The d+1 bound is an upper bound, not claimed sharp in every case.
The related 2009 publisher article was available only as an abstract; specialized antecedents cannot be ruled out.
Finite computational checks corroborate but do not prove universal quantifiers.
title: Two marked vertices determine colour-refinement orbits in every nonbinary Hamming graph
